title.en: The whole exam on one page

description.en: Six questions, two moves: what each question tests and the idea that unlocks it.
description.zh: 六道题，两招：每道题考什么，靠哪个想法解开。

text.en: This mock exam has 100 marks over six questions. They look different, but almost every mark comes from two moves you already know from calculus.
text.zh: 这张模考六道题、共 100 分。题目看着各不相同，可几乎每一分都来自两招，而这两招你在微积分里早就会了。

items.en: **Optimise at the margin.** Keep adding units while one more unit brings in more than it costs; stop where the two are equal. For a firm that is $MR = MC$ (marginal revenue = marginal cost). It answers Q2, Q3, Q4 and Q5.
items.zh: **在边际上求最优。** 多做一个单位，只要带来的比花掉的多，就继续做；两者相等时停下。对厂商来说就是 $MR = MC$（边际收益 marginal revenue = 边际成本 marginal cost）。第 2、3、4、5 题都靠它。

items.en: **Add up areas.** What buyers gain, what sellers earn, what a tax raises and what is lost are areas between curves (integrals, mostly triangles). It answers Q1c and Q2c.
items.zh: **把面积加起来。** 买方得到的、卖方赚到的、税收收上来的、白白损失的，都是曲线之间的面积（积分，大多就是三角形）。第 1c、2c 题靠它。

text.en: Q6 is the one exception: a macro model you argue on a diagram, with no numbers.
text.zh: 第 6 题是唯一的例外：一个宏观模型，在图上讲道理，不用算数。

rows.en: A quota on imported wind turbines

rows.zh: 垄断厂商，再加 25% 的税

rows.en: Many small firms, in the long run

text.en: Most of the vocabulary is calculus you already know under another name. Keep this table open while you revise.
text.zh: 这门课的大部分术语，其实是你熟悉的微积分换了个名字。复习时把这张表放在手边。

rows.en: a decreasing line; $p(Q)$ is what a buyer will pay for the $Q$-th unit
rows.zh: 一条递减直线；$p(Q)$ 是第 $Q$ 个单位买方最多愿意付的钱

rows.en: the solution of a system: supply = demand, or two best responses at once
rows.zh: 一个方程组的解：供给 = 需求，或两个最优反应同时成立

title.en: How to use this course in 48 hours

text.en: The lessons follow the ideas, not the question numbers: markets first (Q1, Q5), then market power (Q2, Q3, Q4), then growth (Q6). Every lesson has the same five parts, so you always know where you are:
text.zh: 课按想法排，不按题号：先讲市场（第 1、5 题），再讲市场势力（第 2、3、4 题），最后讲增长（第 6 题）。每课都是同样的五部分，随时知道自己在哪：

items.en: **In short**: the answers, and the few ideas the question needs.
items.zh: **速览**：答案，以及这道题要用到的几个想法。

items.en: **The ideas**: each idea from the ground up, with a figure you can drag. Small questions in the page catch the classic mistakes before the exam does.
items.zh: **背后的想法**：每个想法从头讲起，配一张可以拖动的图。页面里的小问题，赶在考试之前替你踩一遍经典的坑。

items.en: **Worked solution**: the exam answer line by line. One line in each is left for you to fill in.
items.zh: **完整解法**：按考试答法一行行写出来。每段解法留一行给你自己填。

items.en: **The wider topic**: what else this kind of question can ask (tariffs, Stackelberg, two-part tariffs...), worked with the same numbers.
items.zh: **这类题的全貌**：同一类题还可能怎么问（关税、斯塔克尔伯格、两部定价……），用同一组数讲完。

items.en: **Your turn**: two or three questions with new numbers.

rows.en: Day 1: this map, then Markets, Long run and Monopoly. Day 2: Price discrimination, Cournot, Malthus, then the drill twice: once open-book, once timed (20 minutes).
rows.zh: 第一天：这张地图，然后市场、长期竞争、垄断。第二天：价格歧视、古诺、马尔萨斯，最后把练习做两遍：一遍开卷，一遍限时（20 分钟）。

rows.en: Each lesson's "In short", "The ideas" and "Worked solution"; skip the wider topic; then the drill.
rows.zh: 每课只看“速览”“背后的想法”“完整解法”，跳过全貌；最后做练习。

rows.en: Each "In short", then the one-page method sheet in the last lesson.
rows.zh: 每课的“速览”，再看最后一课的一页方法表。

items.en: **In the exam**, write the condition before the number (for example "$MR = MC$: $600 - 4Q = 60 + Q$"). If the arithmetic slips, the method still earns marks.
items.zh: **考试时**，先写条件再代数（比如“$MR = MC$：$600 - 4Q = 60 + Q$”）。就算算错了，思路分还在。

items.en: Do the quick, certain parts first (Q5, Q4, Q2a, Q3a); leave Q3b (the packages) for when you are warmed up: it is the hardest idea in the paper.
items.zh: 先做稳拿的（第 5 题、第 4 题、2a、3a）；3b（套餐）留到手热了再做，它是整张卷子最难的想法。

body.en: The Chinese version of this course keeps the English terms beside the Chinese, so you can write your answers in the words the examiner expects.
body.zh: 中文版里专业词后面都留着英文，方便你直接用阅卷人熟悉的词作答。
